user.title: Connect to Amway Atmosphere
user.description:
Please open the following link in your browser to sign in to your Amway account:

[Click here to log in]({auth_url})

After logging in, your browser will redirect to a URL starting with `amwayhealthyhome://loginRedirect?code=...`.
Please copy the entire redirect URL or the `code` parameter and paste it below.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Amway Account
reauth_confirm.description:
Your Amway login session has expired. Please re-authenticate using the link:

[Click here to log in]({auth_url})

Paste the new redirect URL or `code` below.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect or exchange tokens with Amway servers.

abort.already_configured: This Amway account or device is already configured.
